title: Implement libp2p swarm initialization and gossipsub config
description:
Initialize a tokio-backed libp2p Swarm with gossipsub enabled. Configuration: mesh_n=6, mesh_n_low=4, mesh_n_high=12, heartbeat_interval=1s, max_transmit_size=1MB. Expose a GossipHandle for sending and receiving messages. Artifact: transit/src/gossip/swarm.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Swarm compiles and starts on a random TCP port
- Two swarm instances can connect to each other in an integration test
- Gossipsub config values are read from the operator TOML config (not hardcoded)
- Shutdown is clean (all tasks join)
